description: How guard-scope recognises an agent's commits. Each Duo flow gets its own service account, ai-<flow>-<group> (docs/decisions.md, 15 Oct 2026 (b), row 10). A commit is the flow's when its author or committer name, or the local part of either email, matches authorPattern (create_commit lets the model set the author, not the committer). NOT YET CONFIRMED: Gate 5 must record the real author and committer of a create_commit commit (the locus-probe flow records both) and update these patterns.
